name: stylewright
description: Writing skills for coding agents, distilled from named standards.

plugins.name: stylewright-standards
plugins.description: Writing skills distilled from published standards. A grounding matrix accounts for every statement: it cites a numbered rule in the source, or it is marked as our own guidance, or as narrative. CI checks the trace.

plugins.name: stylewright-craft
plugins.description: Discipline with no external standard behind it, covering how an agent writes and how it works. The authority is ours, and each skill says so. bench/ in the repository holds the protocol for measuring what a skill does.
